newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coinstar rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coinstar rated a buy.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist Tuesday started coverage with a buy rating on Coinstar Inc, owner and operator of a nationwide network of automated machines that exchange loose coins into vouchers for cash.
-- expects revenue growth fueled by unit rollout. Sees 1998 revenues rising to $64.7 million from $24.6 million in 1997. Company had revenue of $8.3 million in 1996.

-- expects Coinstar to expand the number of machines in current supermarkets, expand the number of supermarkets with machines, expand the type of stores in which it has machines and to expand the consumer services provided by its machines.
